name: Injuu Genmu III ~Nasty Angel~
source:
In addition to the three familiar girls there are eleven more girls this time as preys for the beasts. Winning in hanafuda matches results in developments and triggering of tentacle scenes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
除了熟悉的三名女孩外，这次又有十一名女孩成为淫兽的猎物。花札对局的胜负将决定剧情发展，并触发触手场景。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/03/vn-of-month-december-2001-izumo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
